name: Nexus-Prince Haramad
shortDescription: Nexus-Prince Haramad, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Consortium leader encountered through an image at the Stormspire; names the crystal search and receives the recovered Ata’mal Crystal. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
